newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock says 70 pct of duplexes sold.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock says 70 pct of duplexes sold.

text.p: Wheelock and Co Ltd's property arm Wheelock Properties Ltd said 70 percent of 58 luxury duplex houses on offer at its Forest Hill development in Tai Po in the New Territories were sold on Saturday.
All 22 duplexes originally on offer were sold in the morning while 18 of an additional batch of 36 units found buyers, the company said in a statement.
It said the duplexes ranged in size from 1,842 to 3,135 square feet but did not say how much they had sold for. The company could not be reached for comment.
When it launched the sales on February 26, it said the duplexes were priced at HK$11.45 million and up.
The company also said a 1,600-square-foot simplex apartment at Forest Hill had sold for HK$10,000 per square foot.
